description: An operations director must authorize a 300-unit welding campaign on an alternate cell after the primary robotic cell becomes unavailable, and finalize the material reservation, fixture work, quality validation, and fume-extraction controls.

shared_context.S1: The robotic welding cell, Cell 6, is unavailable after its controller faulted during a scheduled setup.
shared_context.S2: Cell 3 is idle and is capable of welding the same bracket family with its manual fixture.
shared_context.S3: A customer order calls for 300 brackets from the current production campaign.
shared_context.S4: Elena has authority to approve a temporary route change and release the campaign.
shared_context.S5: Company procedure requires Elena to conduct a pre-release review with quality, maintenance, materials, and safety before approving an alternate-cell campaign.

PF1.text: Victor checked the customer drawing revision in the customer portal yesterday and found that release requires destructive testing of exactly 8 brackets and 100% dimensional inspection of the first exactly 20 brackets; he has not yet updated the campaign traveler.

PF2.text: Nadia inspected Cell 3 this morning and found wear in fixture F-19's jaws. The J-19 replacement kit is in the crib, and replacing and validating the jaws requires exactly 3 maintenance hours; she has not opened the work order.

PF3.text: Owen reconciled the physical blanks this morning and confirmed that lot BQ-18 contains exactly 312 usable blanks: 300 for the order and exactly 12 to reserve for the required destructive and dimensional checks; the inventory adjustment is still pending in the materials system.

PF4.text: Priya measured Cell 3's welding-fume extraction at 0.72 m/s, below the 0.80 m/s minimum. The filter change takes exactly 2 hours and requires an airflow verification before welding; she has not yet issued the safety clearance.

acceptance_conditions: Cell 3 must be selected for the campaign.
Exactly 300 brackets must be scheduled from lot BQ-18, with exactly 12 testing and inspection blanks reserved from the 312 usable blanks.
Exactly 8 brackets must receive destructive testing and the first exactly 20 brackets must receive dimensional inspection.
Fixture F-19 jaws must be replaced and validated in exactly 3 maintenance hours.
Cell 3's extraction filter must be changed in exactly 2 hours and airflow must be verified before welding.
The settlement must record the quality validation, fixture work, material reservation, and extraction clearance commitments.
The customer drawing requirement must be cited as justification after Victor reveals it.

content_checks.C6: decisions['filter_changed'] == True and decisions['extraction_maintenance_hours'] == 2 and decisions['airflow_verified_before_welding'] == True
content_checks.C7: any(c['target'] == 'Victor' and c['type'] in ['traveler_update', 'document_update'] and ('traveler' in c['detail'] or 'inspection' in c['detail']) and ('8' in c['detail'] or '20' in c['detail']) for c in commitments) and any(c['target'] == 'Nadia' and c['type'] in ['work_order', 'maintenance_work_order'] and ('F-19' in c['detail'] or 'fixture' in c['detail']) and ('3' in c['detail'] or 'three' in c['detail']) for c in commitments) and any(c['target'] == 'Owen' and c['type'] in ['inventory_adjustment', 'material_system_update'] and ('BQ-18' in c['detail'] or '312' in c['detail']) and ('12' in c['detail'] or 'reserved' in c['detail']) for c in commitments) and any(c['target'] == 'Priya' and c['type'] in ['safety_clearance', 'safety_filter_replacement', 'safety_clearance_gate'] and ('filter' in c['detail'] or 'extraction' in c['detail']) and ('airflow' in c['detail'] or '0.80' in c['detail']) and ('2' in c['detail'] or 'clearance' in c['detail']) for c in commitments)

decisive_facts.why: The customer drawing changes unspecified release testing to exactly 8 destructive samples and exactly 20 first-off dimensional inspections, and adds the quality-validation commitment.
The worn F-19 jaws change a generic Cell 3 route into replacement and validation of the jaws in exactly 3 maintenance hours with a fixture work-order commitment.

The physical inventory reconciliation fixes lot BQ-18, exactly 300 production blanks, and exactly 12 reserved testing and inspection blanks from the 312 usable blanks, requiring a material-reservation commitment.
The measured 0.72 m/s extraction changes ordinary Cell 3 use into an exactly 2-hour filter change followed by airflow verification and an extraction-clearance commitment.
